answer: Tie each identity's payout tier to a hardware anchor: a signing key sealed inside a distinct TPM chip, attested by its maker. Agents without one still mine, but on a lower terrace capped at 1 POA per epoch, so a cloud farm of 1,000 bare keys earns near the nadir. Climbing up means proving a chip no other address has ever used. Assumption: a TPM-equipped mini PC costs about $150, so 100 top-tier clones need $15,000 of hardware, while an honest agent pays once. Chips can be resold, so each attestation expires yearly.
